content.text:
restart: always

  web_application:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: ./docker/web_application/web_application.Dockerfile
      args:
        USER_ID: $USER_ID
        GROUP_ID: $GROUP_ID
    depends_on:
      - api
      - database
    env_file:
      - ./web_application/.env.local
    environment:
      - API_DOMAIN=http://api
      - NEXTAUTH_URL=http://localhost:3003
    networks:
      - stack
    ports:
      - 3003:3000
    restart: always
